summary:
## Standing operator rules
Never modify files under ledgerly/customer_export/ without posting the proposed diff in #privacy-review and receiving approval from @mina.

Never run Bandit on ledgerly without invoking it through ./tools/scan-ledgerly.sh so its custom exclusions and baseline comparison are applied.

can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?

Important: the active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

## Current objective
Fix nightly reconciliation double-counting refunds in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. Tenacity migration was stopped for next sprint. Payroll approval work is paused, not superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to 6 hours hid stuck jobs for hours. Old per-document embedding clients caused duplicate upserts; per-vector transactions were too slow. Platform-default CSV encoding failed UTF-8 tests; a second writer was unnecessary.

## Plan and progress
- [pending] Inspect reconciliation flow: `sed -n '1,260p' ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`
- [pending] Reproduce, patch, and test duplicate refunds.

## Recent work
Billing annotations and UTC timestamps passed 96 tests and mypy. A refund-credit test exposed incorrect ordering in `apply_credit`, but the report afterward said it looked right. Test setup was refactored with factories, shared organization/customer fixtures, a frozen clock, and parameterized report factories; targeted suites passed. Payroll v3 batch was created successfully.
